how_to_update: For every international or regional event with a real-world location, add one or more entries to places[]. Include the named venue or city, country, latitude/longitude, a source URL that supports the venue, a separate coordinates source, and verified date (YYYY-MM-DD). Prefer official venue/event sources; use clearly labelled community reports when official pages omit a precise play spot. Never label an approximate city-centre point as an official event pin. Add events[] with the event headline and date range. The app links exact event titles first, then matches a place only when its city, country or venue name appears explicitly in the event location and the dates overlap. For multi-city events add one place per named city/venue. Never invent coordinates or activity claims. Tags allowed: Raids, Gyms, PokéStops, Community Day, Event venue. Community-reported hotspot entries are general area pins only; raid activity and lobby fill are not live-verified.
